allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Dragged out on a blind date a year after his wife's tragic death, grieving architect Bob Rueland finds an unexpected spark not with his date, but with Grace, the sharp-witted waitress at a lively Irish-Italian restaurant. Unbeknownst to Bob, Grace is the recipient of his late wife's donated heart. As they grow closer, their romance offers the promise of healing and the weight of a secret that could tear them apart.

facts.title: Return to Me

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: Conventional romcom cues coexist with an unusual donated-heart premise, so familiar versus different is close enough to warrant review.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As an unexpected connection begins to heal them both, an unspoken truth about Grace's heart hangs between them, threatening to unravel everything.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: A year after his wife's death, grieving architect Bob Rueland goes on a blind date and instead falls for Grace, a sharp-witted waitress who unknowingly received his late wife's donated heart.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Warm and heartfelt comedy-romance with heavy emotional undercurrents, moving at an easy, engaging pace ideal for date night.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Bonnie Hunt, this romantic comedy grounds its lively restaurant courtship in profound grief and poignant hope, balancing genuine laughter with tender emotional stakes.
